notes: Summary: mid-market product company building a semantic product search for their main SaaS. Primary ops: nightly batch re-ingest with incremental updates, plus real-time user queries for 'instant' search results.

Current stack: Postgres primary, content stored in S3 (versioned), uses Typesense for keyword search today. Looking to add embeddings layer connected to a vector DB (customer trialed Pinecone but ran into egress costs and cold-cache latency).

Workload specifics: expect 2M initial vectors, ~200k monthly mutations (adds/updates), peak QPS in UI ~120 qps, typical query pattern includes k-NN + filter on metadata (tenant, doc_type). Batch jobs: daily full-embed refresh for changed docs, and weekly full-reindex for ML experiments.
Performance targets: 50-120 ms tail latency for UI search (95th), 100-300ms p50 for similarity endpoints, ingest throughput target: 10k vectors/min for batch window (6hr window preferred).

Model preference: open models for embeddings (sizable preference for low-cost quantized models), but willing to evaluate Redwood's curated model catalog if unit cost is attractive. Want option to route dev/low-priority traffic to cheaper variants.
Routing/fallback: must support deterministic fallback to keyword search if vector DB unavailable; plan: Redwood routing -> vector DB -> fallback to Typesense with cached ID lists.

Security/compliance notes: SSO via Okta required, full audit logs for embed/lookup calls, retention controls for user PII, KMS for customer key management. Data residency: primary NA region but some EU tenants flagged for residency requirements.

POC scope: run a 72-hour throughput POC on Dedicated staging cluster with real dataset (2M vectors), compare hosted_api pilot numbers, validate cold-cache and steady-state latencies, run cost simulation for 1M queries/day.
AE notes: Jordan - 'customer is pragmatic, care about predictable bills and easy scaling. They'll pay for reserved capacity if price delta vs hosted_api is >=15% and we can prove throughput.'

SE notes: Priya - 'Edge cases around metadata filtering need query planner support from vector DB side. Will test Weaviate + Milvus adapters in POC. Also want to benchmark prefix/KV cache improvements.'
Finance note: asked for committed monthly throughput tiers and a 12-month contract option. Need draft SOW + pricing by 2026-03-10.
Open items: exact EU residency plan for the subset of tenants, snapshot/restore SLA for vector DB backups, whether Redwood's Optimize batching suggestions can be automated into their CI pipeline.
